function: CSI compression at the UE and reconstruction at the BS (CSI feedback) in FDD massive MIMO, using learned landmark dictionaries of the CSI manifold (p. 3, 7-8).
system: FDD single-cell massive MIMO downlink; BS ULA with 32 or 64 antennas, single-antenna UE; 3.5 GHz, 15 kHz spacing, 48 RBs; no RIS (p. 3, 8).
method: Manifold learning: landmark dictionaries learned offline from training CSI by alternating optimization; compression and reconstruction by local-geometry-preserving linear combinations; no neural network (p. 7-8).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A (MATLAB, NR Rel. 16), 3.5 GHz, 30 km/h; train/validation/test sets of 100,000/30,000/20,000 samples, MLCF data set N=4000 (p. 8-9).
test_conditions: Train and test on the same CDL-A model; channel-estimation SNR swept 5-30 dB with dictionaries trained on perfect CSI; Nt=32 and 64 shown (p. 8-10).
baselines: Learned: CLNet, NR-CsiNet, FISTA-Net (p. 9); no non-learned CSI-feedback method; random-landmark variant of MLCF only (Fig. 2, p. 9).
metrics: NMSE, cosine similarity, FLOPs, trainable parameters, spectral efficiency with eigen zero-forcing precoding, NMSE under quantization bits (p. 8-11).
complexity: FLOPs 81.6K-96K and 23.7M-26.9M trainable parameters (Table II, p. 9); time complexity orders for compression and reconstruction (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "MLCF method under the industrial CDL channel model, conforming to 3GPP TR 38.901"
q2_support: p. 10: "they are all acquired through training with perfect CSI"; only a channel-estimation SNR sweep, no other scenario, band, speed or antenna count is tested on a trained model.
q3_support: p. 9: "Three DL-based algorithms (CLNet [40], NR-CsiNet [41], FISTA-Net [42]) are introduced as benchmarks"; all are learned, and no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the trainable parameters and floating point of operations (FLOPs), are shown in bold"
q5_support: p. 8: "we carry on the simulation for the 5G new radio (NR) Release 16 and generate the training and testing data sets"; own simulated data, and no link to code or data is given.
notes: Included although the learned component is non-neural: landmark dictionaries trained offline on CSI samples ("learned at the BS beforehand", p. 7) with trainable parameters counted in Table II (p. 9); the reviewer should confirm it counts as learned. q3 is 0: the benchmarks are all learned; the only other curves are a random-landmark variant of MLCF (Fig. 2, an ablation of its landmark selection, not counted as a non-learned baseline) and the perfect-CSI bound (Fig. 7). q2 is 0: Nt=32 and 64 appear in Fig. 3 (p. 10) but the paper does not state that a trained model is tested on the other. The PDF is the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2304.14598v2), which does not print the DOI, so the DOI match rests on the file name.
